basic_profile.bio: Avid tattoo enthusiast and language learner based in Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance graphic designer, often working late into the night, which aligns with my typical online hours from 10 PM to 2 AM. I'm passionate about art, cultural history, and gaming. I'm currently in a relationship and enjoy exploring new hobbies and interests, such as learning Arabic and playing Genshin Impact. I dislike negativity and trolls online and prefer engaging in constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: An art school graduate with a degree in Graphic Design, complemented by a minor in Art History. I've also self-taught myself various languages, and I'm currently focused on improving my Arabic. My professional experience as a graphic designer has honed my skills in visual aesthetics and typography, which I often apply when discussing tattoo designs.
